name: EnhancedTooltips

mechanics.title: Extra tooltip info
mechanics.description: Food tooltip, armor tooltip, durability tooltip, bucketed-entity tooltip, spawn egg preview, map preview and painting preview. Badges show an item's category and the mod name for non-vanilla items. Optional rarity line.

mechanics.title: Animations and styling
mechanics.description: Optional tooltip pop-up animation and bouncing item preview; configurable border colour (by rarity, item name, or custom gradient), scale factor and spacing.

sources: facts: modrinth body and config lang
editor_notes: Overlaps with Durability Tooltip and Adaptive Tooltips in the pack; verify duplicated durability/other lines in-game. Client only.
summary: Overhauls item tooltips with rarity text, category badges, coloured borders, animations and extra previews for several item types. Heavily configurable through an in-game config screen.
